title: tabular_automl round input
description: Evaluation knobs for one round. The dataset itself (task type, features, correlations) is derived inside the referee from the platform's per-round SEED, so nothing about the actual data is carried here — only the (miner-visible, non-secret) operating limits.

n_train.description: Rows of labeled training data handed to the submission in reset().

n_test.description: Rows of held-out data the submission must predict on in act().

n_instances.description: Independent dataset draws of the round's task family that raw_score is averaged over. A single draw per round is an under-sized evaluation (see HANDOFF.md Sec 4) -- this must be large enough that cross-round score variance stays well below the 1% takeover margin.

max_train_time_s.description: Hard wall-clock cap on EACH instance's reset()/fit call. Exceeding it on any instance is a gate failure for the whole round (raw_score 0), not a score penalty.

inference_deadline_ms.description: Hard per-act() deadline for producing predictions on the test batch. Exceeding it is a gate failure.

max_complexity.description: Hard cap on the submission's self-reported model complexity (see README § complexity). Exceeding it is a gate failure, not a continuous penalty.
